content:
Hello, I am starting a project on formalizing some set theory in lean, specifically concerning infinitary combinatorics and martins axiom as found in Kunen's textbook (1980 ed.)

First, I should ask here whether there is any interest in having such results PR’d to mathlib?

Thank you!
I'm not a Mathlib maintainer, but I would be interested. I have an open PR proving Fodor's lemma (#37685), and there's an open PR for the Δ-system lemma (#34246).
